facts.fact: Djibouti launched its national broadband development strategy on 16 October 2024 at a Ministry of Communication workshop, presented by Minister Radwan Abdillahi Bahdon; no end date is given.

We are Tech says the strategy is part of the World Bank-supported Djibouti Digital Foundation project, with early results of 250 km of fibre in the north and over 100 administrative buildings connected.

The government's broadband strategy, launched 16 October 2024, aims to expand fibre coverage and access to fixed and mobile internet across the entire country; early results are 250 km of fibre in the north and over 100 administrative buildings connected, with no rural sites counted.
We are Tech says Djibouti is currently connected to nine submarine fibre-optic cables; landing stations are not named.

DJI.note: A goal of becoming a tech hub by 2035 is not a startup law, strategy or fund.
No hub, incubator or park is named; the 2035 tech hub aim is a goal.
